A123 Systems is headquartered in Novi, Michigan, and was founded in 2001. The company operates as a manufacturer of lithium-ion batteries.

The company produces lithium-ion batteries for automotive and industrial applications. Specific manufacturing processes, facility size, and production volumes are not publicly disclosed.

Its customer base spans the automotive and industrial sectors, though specific client names are not provided.

The company has not publicly stated a specific founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond its product focus.
